name: Dr. Ada Merkel
quote: The best-performing structures are engineered early, while ideas are still cheap to change.
bio: Ada founded Merkel Engineering in 1998 after a decade designing tall buildings across Europe. She holds a doctorate in structural engineering and has led the practice through more than six hundred commissions, from super-tall frames to fjord-spanning bridges. She still reviews every major structural scheme the studio puts its name to.
